_comment: Input to scripts/audio/build.mjs. Every time is in seconds of the SOURCE as downloaded. See docs/AUDIO.md for why each number has its value; src/assets/audio/SOURCES.md records the result.

sources.name: laugh_distant
sources.note: Eleven separate laughs split by silence. Shipped whole; the director plays one phrase at a time.

sources.name: hunter_breath
sources.note: The user's 0-8 s loop, plus 0.3 s past it for the runtime seam builder.

sources.name: crt_static
sources.note: Stationary noise (RMS flat to 0.1 dB across the clip), so any 9 s loops.

sources.name: rain_bed
sources.note: 11-hour video; only the first 25 min are fetched. 31 s is the start of the 5:00 window with the steadiest 3 s loudness (std 1.99 dB) and no silence.

sources.name: caught_sting
sources.note: Starts 10 ms before the jump into the loudest stretch (8.72 s); capped at 5 s.

sources.name: breathing
sources.note: Two of the quietest inter-breath minima (1.52 s, 13.45 s), ten 1.19 s cycles apart.

sources.name: steps_metal
sources.note: Six footfalls, each a heel-and-toe pair 0.13 s apart.

sources.name: candle
sources.note: Crackle with no structure longer than a second, so 20 s loops without a recognisable repeat.

sources.name: lockbox_open
sources.note: Latch clicks, a long creak, then the lid settling. The lid animation is timed off these events.

sources.name: stalk_breath
sources.note: Each appearance takes a fresh 4 s window starting in [0:05, 0:16] of the source, so it ends by 0:20.

sources.name: hunter_steps
sources.note: Slow walk, a pause, then a run. Excerpts keep that order.
